mapper.select: select c.mps_cell_id, r.item_id, c.bucket_date, c.plan_qty from aps_mps_cell c join aps_mps_row r on r.mps_row_id = c.mps_row_id where c.mps_id = #{mpsId} order by r.item_id, c.bucket_date
select p.item_id from aps_item_param p where p.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and p.use_yn = 'Y' order by p.item_id

select w.wo_id, w.wo_no, w.item_id, w.plan_start, w.plan_end, w.plan_qty - coalesce((select sum(r.qty) from prd_receipt r where r.wo_id = w.wo_id), 0) as remain_qty from prd_wo w where w.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and w.status in ('PLANNED', 'RELEASED', 'IN_PROGRESS') order by w.wo_no, w.wo_id
select p.item_id, p.safety_qty, p.lot_rule, p.lot_qty, p.lot_mult, p.make_lead_days from aps_item_param p where p.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and p.use_yn = 'Y' and p.item_id in #{id}
select c.cust_id, c.cust_cd from mst_cust c where c.cust_id in #{id}

insert into aps_mrp (comp_cd, mrp_no, plant_cd, mrp_nm, horizon_start, horizon_days, mps_id, out_days, item_cnt, order_cnt, exc_cnt, calculated_by, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{m.mrpNo}, #{m.plantCd}, #{m.mrpNm}, #{m.horizonStart}, #{m.horizonDays}, #{m.mpsId}, #{m.outDays}, #{m.itemCnt}, #{m.orderCnt}, #{m.excCnt}, #{by}, #{by}, #{by}) returning mrp_id
mapper.insert:
insert into aps_mrp_item (comp_cd, mrp_id, item_id, llc, proc_type, unit_cd, mps_yn, stock_qty, safety_qty, lot_rule, lot_qty, lot_mult, moq, order_mult, lead_days, lead_src, cust_id) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{mrpId}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.llc}, #{r.procType}, #{r.unitCd}, #{r.mpsYn}, #{r.stockQty}, #{r.safetyQty}, #{r.lotRule}, #{r.lotQty}, #{r.lotMult}, #{r.moq}, #{r.orderMult}, #{r.leadDays}, #{r.leadSrc}, #{r.custId})

insert into aps_mrp_elem (comp_cd, mrp_id, elem_seq, item_id, dir, kind, elem_date, qty, past_due_yn, start_date, late_yn, parent_seq, ref_id, ref_no) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{mrpId}, #{r.elemSeq}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.dir}, #{r.kind}, #{r.elemDate}, #{r.qty}, #{r.pastDueYn}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.lateYn}, #{r.parentSeq}, #{r.refId}, #{r.refNo})

insert into aps_mrp_peg (comp_cd, mrp_id, demand_seq, supply_seq, qty) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{mrpId}, #{r.demandSeq}, #{r.supplySeq}, #{r.qty})

insert into aps_mrp_exc (comp_cd, mrp_id, item_id, exc_cd, elem_seq, cur_date, sug_date, qty, ref_no) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{mrpId}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.excCd}, #{r.elemSeq}, #{r.curDate}, #{r.sugDate}, #{r.qty}, #{r.refNo})
mapper.select: select status from aps_mrp where mrp_id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update aps_mrp set status = 'DISCARDED', discard_reason = #{reason}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where mrp_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'CALC'
mapper.sql: m.mrp_id, m.mrp_no, m.plant_cd, m.mrp_nm, m.horizon_start, m.horizon_days, m.mps_id, s.mps_no, m.out_days, m.status, m.item_cnt, m.order_cnt, m.exc_cnt, m.calculated_at, m.calculated_by, m.discard_reason, m.row_ver
mapper.select: select t.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, t.llc, t.proc_type, t.unit_cd, t.mps_yn, trim_scale(t.stock_qty)::text as stock_qty, trim_scale(t.safety_qty)::text as safety_qty, t.lot_rule, trim_scale(t.lot_qty)::text as lot_qty, trim_scale(t.lot_mult)::text as lot_mult, trim_scale(t.moq)::text as moq, trim_scale(t.order_mult)::text as order_mult, t.lead_days, t.lead_src, c.cust_cd, (select count(*) from aps_mrp_elem e where e.mrp_id = t.mrp_id and e.item_id = t.item_id and e.kind in ('MPS', 'PLAN')) as order_cnt, (select trim_scale(coalesce(sum(e.qty), 0))::text from aps_mrp_elem e where e.mrp_id = t.mrp_id and e.item_id = t.item_id and e.kind in ('MPS', 'PLAN')) as order_qty, (select count(*) from aps_mrp_exc x where x.mrp_id = t.mrp_id and x.item_id = t.item_id) as exc_cnt from aps_mrp_item t join mst_item i on i.item_id = t.item_id left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = t.cust_id where t.mrp_id = #{mrpId} and t.item_id = #{itemId} order by t.llc, i.item_cd, t.item_id

select x.exc_id, x.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, x.exc_cd, x.elem_seq, e.kind as elem_kind, x.cur_date, x.sug_date, trim_scale(x.qty)::text as qty, x.ref_no from aps_mrp_exc x join mst_item i on i.item_id = x.item_id left join aps_mrp_elem e on e.mrp_id = x.mrp_id and e.elem_seq = x.elem_seq where x.mrp_id = #{mrpId} order by i.item_cd, x.cur_date nulls first, x.exc_id limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: e.elem_seq, e.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, e.dir, e.kind, e.elem_date, trim_scale(e.qty)::text as qty, e.past_due_yn, e.start_date, e.late_yn, e.parent_seq, e.ref_id, e.ref_no, i.proc_type
